title: fix: skip inject_event when inject flow type is wrong

proposed.title: Reject incompatible flows before constructing injection events

saved.title: Reject incompatible flows before constructing injection events
saved.body:
Symptom: Injecting a WebSocket message with a bare @focus string crashes with AttributeError instead of reporting an incompatible flow.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/proxyserver.py:Proxyserver.inject_websocket, Proxyserver.inject_tcp, and Proxyserver.inject_udp logged failed eligibility checks but continued constructing events and calling inject_event, which accessed flow.client_conn.
Fix pattern: Return immediately after warning when an injection eligibility check fails, before constructing messages or dispatching events.
Constraints: WebSocket injection requires an HTTPFlow with websocket set; TCP and UDP injection require TCPFlow and UDPFlow respectively. Eligible flows must still reach the existing live-connection handling; test/mitmproxy/addons/test_proxyserver.py:test_inject_fail covers both invalid inputs and a TCP flow without a live connection.

title: Fix a flow reader bug found with fuzzing

proposed.title: Reject non-dictionary flow records before migration

saved.title: Reject non-dictionary flow records before migration
saved.body:
Symptom: Loading a malformed flow dump containing a null record fails without the intended invalid-flow handling.
Root cause: mitmproxy/io/io.py:FlowReader passed decoded tnetstring values to flow migration without checking that they were dictionaries.
Fix pattern: Validate the decoded value before migration inside the existing ValueError handler, so invalid records become FlowReadException errors.
Constraints: Applies to tnetstring flow records; the dictionary check validates the outer type only, not the contents of a flow state.

proposed.title: Size HAR request bodies from raw content

saved.title: Size HAR request bodies from raw content
saved.body:
Symptom: HAR export crashes when a flow contains malformed content encoding.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar computed request bodySize using request.content, whose decoding can raise ValueError.
Fix pattern: Compute byte-size metadata from request.raw_content, returning 0 for absent or empty bytes, without decoding the body.
Constraints: Applies to HAR request bodySize, not decoded payload text. test/mitmproxy/addons/test_savehar.py:test_content_raises verifies HAR export succeeds even when both request.content and response.content raise ValueError.

proposed.title: URL reconstruction preserves string or byte representation
Normalize asterisk request targets in request URL properties

saved.title: URL reconstruction preserves string or byte representation
saved.body:
Symptom: Reconstructing a URL from byte components produces Python byte-literal notation instead of a usable byte URL.
Root cause: mitmproxy/net/http/url.py:unparse used string interpolation for byte components.
Fix pattern: Select string or byte construction based on the scheme type, preserving the corresponding return type; test/mitmproxy/net/http/test_url.py:test_unparse covers byte reconstruction.
Constraints: Use consistently typed string or byte components and supply an explicit path; the overloads do not promise support for mixed representations.

saved.title: Normalize asterisk request targets in request URL properties
saved.body:
Invariant: Request URL properties must render the '*' request target as an empty URL path while preserving the stored request path.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/http.py:Request.url and mitmproxy/http.py:Request.pretty_url each normalize the path before calling url.unparse.
Layering: mitmproxy/net/http/url.py:unparse appends the supplied path without interpreting '*'; request-target semantics belong in the request properties.
Constraints: Keep both properties aligned when composing full URLs; Request.url retains its separate authority-format branch. Skipping normalization appends '*' to the rendered URL.

title: Fix error while changing string-based options

proposed.title: Read byte-column editor text through the underlying widget

saved.title: Read byte-column editor text through the underlying widget
saved.body:
Symptom: Changing string-based console options such as mode or dns_name_servers raises AttributeError: 'AttrMap' object has no attribute 'get_text'.
Root cause: mitmproxy/tools/console/grideditor/col_bytes.py:Edit.get_data called get_text() on the wrapper stored in self._w.
Fix pattern: Read text through self._w.base_widget.get_text()[0], then strip it and convert it with strutils.escaped_str_to_bytes.
Constraints: Applies to text retrieval in the byte-column grid editor; preserve whitespace stripping and escaped-byte conversion. This does not establish a rule for other wrapper operations.

title: Do not block local mode connections

proposed.title: Local mode bypasses client IP blocking

saved.title: Local mode bypasses client IP blocking
saved.body:
Symptom: Local mode connections are rejected by the block addon based on their peer IP address.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/block.py:Block.client_connected applied address-based blocking without exempting local mode; on macOS, the peer address may be the interface's public IP.
Fix pattern: In Block.client_connected, return early for clients whose proxy_mode is mode_specs.LocalMode, before applying private/global address blocking; preserve the existing loopback exemption.
Constraints: This exemption applies to local mode regardless of peer address. Other proxy modes retain address-based safeguards. test/mitmproxy/addons/test_block.py:test_ignore_local_mode verifies that a local client with a private peer address is accepted with block_private enabled.

title: Fix decompressing fake pointers in DNS messages

proposed.title: Tolerate fake compression pointers in DNS record data

saved.title: Tolerate fake compression pointers in DNS record data
saved.body:
Symptom: Decompressing a DNS SOA record fails when numeric data resembles a domain-name compression pointer.
Root cause: mitmproxy/net/dns/domain_names.py:decompress_from_record_data treats bytes with the pointer-indicator bits as candidates and previously let struct.error from attempted decompression escape.
Fix pattern: Catch struct.error around candidate decoding and replacement; leave failed candidates unchanged and advance one byte so scanning continues. Successfully decoded pointers still expand normally.
Constraints: This fallback applies to scanning mixed record data, where pointer-like bytes can belong to other data types. It catches struct.error only and does not detect false pointers that decode successfully; regression coverage is in test/mitmproxy/net/dns/test_domain_names.py:test_record_data_contains_fake_pointer.

proposed.title: IDNA-encode Unicode DNS names when constructing certificate names

saved.title: IDNA-encode Unicode DNS names when constructing certificate names
saved.body:
Symptom: Proxying a Unicode domain fails when generating its certificate.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/tlsconfig.py:_ip_or_dns_name passed Unicode domain strings directly to x509.DNSName.
Fix pattern: In _ip_or_dns_name, IDNA-encode DNS values and decode the result to an ASCII string before constructing x509.DNSName; Unicode SNI then appears as punycode in certificate alternative names.
Constraints: Apply this conversion only after IP-address parsing fails; valid IP literals must remain x509.IPAddress values.

proposed.title: Keep overflowing view options menus scrollable

saved.title: Keep overflowing view options menus scrollable
saved.body:
Symptom: The view options menu overflows when its list becomes too tall.
Root cause: The dropdown used by web/src/js/components/contentviews/ViewSelector.tsx:ViewSelector lacked a menu height limit and vertical scrolling.
Fix pattern: Bound dropdown menu height and enable vertical scrolling; this fix uses max-height: 250px and overflow-y: scroll. ViewSelector also uses top-end placement.
Constraints: The height and scrolling treatment lives in shared dropdown styling; the top-end placement is configured specifically in ViewSelector. This pattern addresses menu overflow, not option selection behavior.

title: web: don't crash when opening options

proposed.title: Keep option help text out of the choices argument

saved.title: Keep option help text out of the choices argument
saved.body:
Symptom: mitmweb crashes when opening options.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar.load passed a separate help-text string as the positional choices argument for hardump.
Fix pattern: Combine the complete description into one help argument; mitmproxy/addonmanager.py:Loader.add_option asserts that choices is not a string to catch this registration mistake.
Constraints: Applies to addon option registration; prose belongs in help, while choices must not be a bare string. The assertion does not prohibit actual choice collections.

proposed.title: Resolve postponed annotations during command signature inspection

saved.title: Resolve postponed annotations during command signature inspection
saved.body:
Symptom: Commands defined in modules using `from __future__ import annotations` fail to execute.
Root cause: `mitmproxy/command.py:Command` and `mitmproxy/command.py:verify_arg_signature` inspected signatures without evaluating string annotations.
Fix pattern: Use `inspect.signature(..., eval_str=True)` in both command signature construction and argument-signature verification.
Constraints: Applies to command callable inspection, including postponed annotations; preserve the existing `sig.bind(*args, **kwargs)` argument validation.

proposed.title: Preserve upstream proxy mode when selecting the HTTP layer

saved.title: Preserve upstream proxy mode when selecting the HTTP layer
saved.body:
Invariant: The HTTP layer added in this stack-construction branch must use HTTPMode.upstream when context.layers[0] is a modes.HttpUpstreamProxy, and HTTPMode.regular otherwise.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/addons/next_layer.py:NextLayer checks the first context layer before constructing layers.HttpLayer.
Failure if skipped: Unconditionally selecting HTTPMode.regular assigns regular HTTP handling to an upstream proxy stack.
Constraints: This rule applies to the HTTP-layer construction branch shown here; it does not establish mode-selection rules for other branches.

proposed.title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains

saved.title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains
saved.body:
Symptom: Draining pending connection writes can fail when transports change concurrently.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/server.py:ConnectionHandler.drain_writers iterated the live transports dictionary across an await of writer.drain().
Fix pattern: Snapshot the dictionary values into a list before iterating across awaits; retain the drain lock and the writer-is-not-None guard.
Constraints: Applies when a mutable dictionary may change while iteration is suspended; the snapshot stabilizes iteration membership, not the state of individual transports.

title: remove overambitious assertion found with fuzzing, fix #5343

proposed.title: Ignore late events for completed HTTP streams

saved.title: Ignore late events for completed HTTP streams
saved.body:
Symptom: Late HTTP data for an already completed stream can trigger an assertion failure.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/layers/http/__init__.py:HttpLayer assumed events for missing streams could only be RequestProtocolError or ResponseProtocolError.
Fix pattern: Ignore events when the stream lookup raises KeyError; completed streams may still receive data or errors.
Constraints: This applies to events whose stream is absent from self.streams; events for existing streams must still be dispatched through event_to_child.

proposed.title: Recover from an uninitialized Windows transparent-mode resolver connection

saved.title: Recover from an uninitialized Windows transparent-mode resolver connection
saved.body:
Symptom: Transparent mode raises AttributeError when resolving the original destination before the upstream connection has been established.
Root cause: mitmproxy/platform/windows.py:Resolver.original_addr writes to self.wfile before it has been initialized.
Fix pattern: Include AttributeError alongside EOFError and OSError in the lookup's recovery handler; call Resolver._connect to initialize wfile, then retry original_addr.
Constraints: This recovery applies to the Windows resolver's original-destination lookup with an uninitialized connection; it does not establish a general policy for catching AttributeError elsewhere.
